description: Use this tool whenever a user asks whether a rollover between two retirement account types is permitted under the IRS Rollover Chart (Roth IRA, Traditional/Rollover IRA, SIMPLE IRA, SEP-IRA, Governmental 457(b), Qualified Plan 401(k), 403(b), Designated Roth 401(k)), how to avoid the mandatory 20% IRC Sec. 3405(c) indirect withholding trap, or how Rule of 55, 457(b) separation, SIMPLE 2-year rules, employer stock NUA, and 20-year plan fee drag apply.

age.description: Account owner age (screens Rule of 55 and pre-59.5 early withdrawal exceptions).

amount.description: Account balance being evaluated for rollover in USD.

currentPlanAllInFeePct.description: Current employer plan all-in expense + admin fee percentage (compared against CleverAlpha 0.25% advisory fee).

hasEmployerStockNua.description: True if the source 401(k) holds appreciated company stock eligible for IRC Sec. 402(e)(4) Net Unrealized Appreciation.

transferMethod.description: 'direct' for Direct Trustee-to-Trustee Transfer (Form 1099-R Code G, 0% withholding) or 'indirect' for 60-day check payable to participant (20% mandatory withholding from employer plans).

name: analyze_401k_rollover_options
title: Analyze 401(k), 403(b), 457(b), SIMPLE & IRA Rollover Eligibility, 20% Withholding Trap & 20-Yr Fee Drag
